entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、観測revisionの連続性とsupersession、late-arrival、source correction、custody event、最新snapshot整合、governance routingを再現可能に検証し、実データなしやexample-onlyを真実と誤認せず、npm test・portable・AOF組織検証・公開releaseを完了すること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Visionary frames temporal evidence integrity as the next empirical-calibration boundary; Builder can extend calibration-report locally; Guardian requires immutable history, explicit correction lineage, custody sequencing, current-snapshot reproduction, and governance without truth or authority claims.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: No independently verified operational ledger history or custody evidence is committed, so source truth, custody authenticity, empirical calibration, and transportability remain unestablished.
entries.expectation_state: Append-only outcome collection policy, observation revisions, source corrections, custody history, current-snapshot alignment, governance, documentation, fixtures, and portable validation are complete; example remains collecting, example-only, and insufficient.
entries.mismatch_state: No independently verified operational ledger history or custody evidence is committed, so source truth, custody authenticity, empirical calibration, and transportability remain unestablished.
